handlers.name: SceneResource_EndCommandStream
handlers.contract: Exit the active interpreter through the shared A1/A2 epilogue.

handlers.name: SceneResource_AdvanceX
handlers.contract: Add one signed stream byte to D0.

handlers.name: SceneResource_AdvanceY
handlers.contract: Add one signed stream byte to D1.

handlers.name: SceneResource_FillTileRow
handlers.contract: Write a counted horizontal VDP tile run.

handlers.name: SceneResource_FillTileColumn
handlers.contract: Write a counted vertical VDP tile run.

handlers.name: SceneResource_FillTileRectangle
handlers.contract: Write a counted width-by-height VDP tile rectangle.

handlers.name: SceneResource_RunServiceFrames
handlers.contract: Run counted actor/render service frames with VBlank and query-latch termination.

handlers.name: SceneResource_AdvanceTileRow
handlers.contract: Increment D1 and clear the tile X cursor.

handlers.name: SceneResource_SetTileBase0000
handlers.contract: Set scene-resource tile base offset to 0x0000.

handlers.name: SceneResource_SetTileBase2000
handlers.contract: Set scene-resource tile base offset to 0x2000.

handlers.name: SceneResource_SetTileBase4000
handlers.contract: Set scene-resource tile base offset to 0x4000.

handlers.name: SceneResource_SetTileBase6000
handlers.contract: Set scene-resource tile base offset to 0x6000.

handlers.name: SceneResource_LoadStreamPointer
handlers.contract: Consume a 24-bit pointer and install it in A4.

handlers.name: SceneResource_LoadOrClearC000
handlers.contract: Load the installed C000 resource or clear VRAM C000.

handlers.name: SceneResource_PrepareFrameAndPalette
handlers.contract: Wait, begin palette transition, clear C000, and upload palette band 3.

handlers.name: SceneResource_InstantiateActorRecord
handlers.contract: Consume a template/X/Y record and initialize one scene-resource actor.
